$Comment: The reward quest that hands a new player the Sawmill: gather the makings, then deliver them
back to the guide at the hub.
Both gathering steps sit on Order 1, so the wood and the planks can be worked in either order;
the delivery step is Order 2 and only unlocks once both are done. Its own TurnInNpcId 'giver'
locks the hand-in to Npc.ViewId (the hub), so the planks can only be delivered there. AutoClaim
pays the Sawmill and the Woodcutting XP out the instant that delivery is made, so there is never
a finished-but-uncollected quest sitting around waiting on a separate turn-in trip.
Target 'Wood' on the chop step and '_Planks' on the craft and delivery steps both match on
CONTAINS, so every wood species counts toward the total rather than one specific type; '_Planks'
also happens to catch the half-plank cut of each species, which is a fair reading of 'planks'.
AutoAccept is off deliberately: this is an optional beat off the main tutorial branch, offered
from the guide's quest list once gather_the_basics is finished, not forced on everybody.
To retune the grind, edit the three Amounts; to change the payout, edit Rewards - the Sawmill
itself is the first entry, so replacing or removing it changes what this quest is actually for.
